messages:
jess: FYI I just finished the BlueQuartz health review — they're seeing 170–220ms p95 on chat completions and revenue signal shows churn risk if SLA doesn't improve :worried:
ryan: Ack. Are those spikes across the board or correlated with long prompts?
nina: Looking at traces — most tail latency comes from longer context + KV cache misses. Their model is a 30B fp16 variant, unquantized.
jess: Right. Customer asks for cost-friendly ops too. My proposal: pilot int8 quantized variant + prefer-dedicated routing for their high-priority routes during business hours.
matt: +1. We should also suggest a compact 7B fallback for bursty traffic to avoid queuing. Can do canary with 5% traffic.
ryan: For routing, recommend policy: route by priority tag -> dedicated pool in us-west -> fallback to hosted-compact-7b. That keeps latency bounded and cost predictable.
nina: I'll prepare model artifacts. Two quick notes: 1) int8 may need an attention kernel tweak for their seq length 2048; 2) measure regen-quality delta on the eval set.
jess: Good call. Can you draft the eval prompt set and a short A/B script? We need to capture fidelity metrics and token-cost delta for the CS deck.
nina: Drafted, posting snippet: ```json
{"canary":{"percent":5},"models":[{"name":"bluequartz-30b-int8","route":"dedicated-usw"},{"name":"bluequartz-7b-compact","route":"hosted-fallback"}]}
```
ryan: Deploy notes: enable KV-prefetch and warm cache on canary nodes, set per-route timeout 2.5s, and circuit-breaker to failover after 1 retry. I'll add to the rollout script.
matt: Ops ask: what's the expected cost change? ballpark numbers for CS to present?
nina: Rough estimate: int8 ~35% token cost reduction vs fp16; compact 7b ~70% reduction on fallback traffic. Latency: int8 p95 expected ~+10–20ms vs fp16 for short seqs, but overall p95 improves due to fewer queue waits.
jess: Perfect. I'll write the enablement playbook and schedule a 30-min handoff with BlueQuartz next Tue. Also logging ask: capture prompt/eval ids for any quality regressions and flag in the console.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-8421 for canary rollout and link ML-EVAL-619.
jess: Thanks — tagging @nina @ryan @matt. Nina, can you drop the eval suite and a quick checklist by EOD? We'll share with BlueQuartz and propose the canary window Thu 9–11am PT.
nina: Will do. Posting checklist now.
jess: Great — this should give them clear path to lower unit cost and stabilize latency ahead of renewal. :pray:
